verdict.reason: the engines agree on every compared channel at 25 checkpoint(s), and 22 prediction(s) hold on the independent engine

limitations: OAM is not compared: FCEUX 2.6 exposes no OAM read to Lua (the fixtures draw no sprites)
frames are numbered differently by the two engines; the program's NMI entries and $4016 latches are the common clock
the comparison code is NES Forge's (shared with the editor); the execution is FCEUX's
